text: 11月13日，沪深两市全天成交额合计16556.68亿元。其中，沪市成交额为7706.14亿元；深市成交额为8850.54亿元；创业板成交额为4377.29亿元。
text_en: On November 13, total turnover across the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was RMB 1,655.668 billion. Of this, Shanghai market turnover was RMB 770.614 billion; Shenzhen market turnover was RMB 885.054 billion; ChiNext turnover was RMB 437.729 billion.
